priorityList: Interrupt with Spear Hand Strike when the target is casting.
Use Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally paired with potions and trinkets.
Use Zenith when Xuen is active or if you are about to cap charges, especially if Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury are on cooldown.
Use Celestial Conduit when Zenith is active and your primary rotational abilities (RSK, FoF, SotW) are on cooldown.
Use Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires both Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to be on cooldown).
Use Fists of Fury on cooldown, prioritizing it if you have 30 Flurry Charges or during Bloodlust.
Use Strike of the Windlord on cooldown.
Use Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Use Rising Sun Kick on cooldown.
Use Touch of Death whenever it becomes available.
Use Spinning Crane Kick if Dance of Chi-Ji is active, especially at 2 stacks or if the buff is about to expire.
Use Blackout Kick if Combo Breaker is active to avoid wasting the proc.
Use Tiger Palm if you have less than 4 Chi and your Energy is near maximum capacity.
Use Blackout Kick as your primary Chi spender filler, ensuring you never cast it twice in a row to maintain Combo Strikes.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi as needed, always alternating with other abilities to maintain Combo Strikes.
